method: Six fresh cars naturally launch to 100 km/h and enter a full-throttle turn. Only after production TorqueScale drops to <=0.8, change one ownership/assist condition for 0.2s: TCS off, RCCP_AI ownership signal externalControl, external input override, engine off, component disabled, canControl off. The actual AI navigation component is not attached to this flat-road probe. Fixed-step observations; no teleport or velocity writes.
acceptance: Every case must first demonstrate active protection (TorqueScale <=0.8), then restore TorqueScale to 1 within the next physics step and hold it for 0.2s; engine maximum torque remains within 0.01 Nm. Flags are restored after observation. Handling bounds do not apply while the assist is intentionally bypassed.
